notes.title: TPP 1.04 Released!
notes.content:
A few changes have appeared in The Painter's Playground, especially for Daily Challenges!
* New topics have been added
* You can now use all tools on dailies
* You can also use all colors
* You have total freedom for the Daily Challenge!

A few other more minor things have been changed or added, but you're not likely to actually notice them ;)

Enjoy,
Bob
NZM

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.03
notes.content:
Feb. 22 at Noon EST, The Painter's Playground 1.03 is available. A lot has been accomplished in the past two weeks, and we couldn't have done it without our awesome community of artists and collectors.

Here are the patch notes, please read carefully, since it differs from the previous announcement.

Fixed:

Cleared up a bug that was causing improper displays in the leaderboards.
Cleared up an even more insidious bug that was giving everyone the wrong number of "thumbs given".


Changed:

Zoom level has been increased.
The base calculated price of paintings has been slightly decreased.
You can now set the prices of your paintings *lower*, as has been requested.
Removing a painting from being on sale can lower its market value. Seller beware!

 
Noticed:

Something I put in a long time ago, and forgot about... 
When you're in the Harbor, you can press 'S' on the keyboard to see which paintings *you* are selling. 
You can also press 'W' to see which paintings you are showcasing. 
I'm not sure whether this will be developed further, removed, or left alone.


Added:

There is now an "Are you sure" pop-up window when flagging a painting.
You can now click on an artist's name in the Harbor or Community gallery, and see all their public paintings.
You can now use the TAB key to scroll through your favorite colors, in addition to the existing 1,2,3,4,5,6 hotkeys.
Press SHIFT while painting to save your work in progress. This happens automatically occasionally, but better safe than sorry ;)
There are now "search modes" in the Community Showcase gallery!
There is now a "folder" button in the lower right in Your Private Gallery. This opens the media folder on your computer where your local paintings are stored, to make it easy to share your work with the world. 
So please share your work with the world: twitter, instagram, deviant art, facebook, etc.


Twittered:

You can now tweet links to finished paintings:
Go to "Settings" and turn Auto-Tweet On.
Each time you finish a painting in your studio and you upload it directly to the Harbor, you will have the option to tweet it to your followers.
This also works when completing a daily challenge.
It does not work in Oyster mode.
Paintings that are not immediately uploaded can not be auto-tweeted, because there is nothing to link to.
But with the new easy access to your media folder, you might be able to do this yourself ;)


Improved:

Steam Achievement Tracking


Started:

Looking deeper into achievement tracking, due to player reports.


WARNED:

Steam cloud is not perfect. Due to the nature of the game, it has a lot of files, and this can take a long time to sync up, especially on slow connections and/or old machines.
Orinigally, we had it so that your local gallery paintings were not stored in the steam cloud.
But then users were missing paintings between computers.
So now, the steam cloud has been set to include your local gallery.
If you notice problems, let us know, and you can contact Bob directly at saunders72 at hotmail dot com



The Future:
We are working on our road map for The Painter's Playground right now. We can do a small-to-medium sized update in about one month, or a larger one in about three months. 

We'd really like to give you some new painting tools, we've had lots of suggestions from this thread. Getting them right will take time. And there's also the Golden Gallery to think about, *and* an art gallery companion app on Android!!! So yeah, busy ːsteamhappyː

Keep painting, spread the word, and enjoy!

Bob
NZM

notes.title: Beta 5c
notes.content:
The second update for 2018 is here, with the following notable changes:

added the names of colors to pop-ups in merchant and during play. Thank you color consultant!
we have a new 4th tab of colors, including flesh tones, metals, and royals.
took out a lot of superfluous server calls.
found another security hole and patched it ;)
there is now a "cancel" button when selecting canvas size, meaning you don't always have to start a painting.
added a "button pressing animation" to some things in the studio.
the "achievements" screen is now called "Career", and has more infomation and several sub-options.
UI skins can now be purchased at the crafty merchant, and turned on in the "Career" screen, from the main menu.
other new crafty merchant functions are also activated.
sound effects have been updated
added new steam achievements, for a current total of 96!


On the forums, I mentioned I would try putting the canvas behind the UI during painting. Well, I tried it, and it completely conflicted with the way painting and tool selection work. 

Final polish work continues, launch is less than 1 month away!

Bob, NZM

notes.title: Beta 4G
notes.content:
12/15/17 , The Painter's Playground, Beta 4G

This update contains changes to the Daily Challenge, an accuracy fix for the detail pen and paint bucket, and some new one-time pop-up menus for galleries.

The version number displayed on the first screen is wrong! It says '4f'. Ignore that.... Now the things I got right:


 i improved the accuracy of the detail pen
 i made it so that a first-time player would go straight to the studio
 i fixed an error (caused by the above change), where new users would be unable to do anything (WHOA!)
 i found the error that was making people's paintings upload under the wrong user number! (i also fixed it)
 i set up the "featured artist" search in the Harbor.
 i fixed an issue for canvas detection in portrait mode
 i fixed the error where selecting paint bucket would change brush size.
 i created a pop-up window that allows you to view the daily challenge gallery without creating an entry
 you now receive a copy of all paintings you make in the daily challenge.
 you may now vote on Daily Challenge paintings from previous days
 there is no longer a "winner" for daily challenges, judge for yourself! 
 I changed the amount of Bits and Renown you get for making Daily Draws: it scales with artist level.
 each vote cast now costs 10 bits.
 voting 3 times in 1 play session grants +1 renown per second for 12 hours.
 the first time you view a gallery, you get a pop-up about it. For existing users, i apologize, but it will only happen once!



OK, enjoy, and please send any technical issues to me (Bob) at
saunders72 at hotmail dot com

notes.title: Security Update
notes.content:
Hello Artists!

Today I released a new version of The Painter's Playground on steam that addresses several existing technical issues. 

Warning:
Your current temporary "work in progress" files will be invalidated by this update. So finish whatever you're doing before getting this. (no other files will be affected)


 added: skip button for daily challenge: just go straight to daily challenge gallery
 added: for now, everyone gets a new random ui every time they enter a painting screen. these will later be purchasable.
 added: a prototype "level up progress bar"
 added: many new steam achievements!

 changed: level up screen format. each point is now a separate screen

 fixed several security issues discovered by one of our awesome community members
 fixed a server session time-out issue
 fixed several leaderboard-related issues


Thanks for playing, and keep up the great work!

Bob, Next Zen Mechanics
